description.value: Miller's Fries appears to be a food truck operating on the grounds of The Beer Farmers, a 4th-generation certified organic family farm in Pemberton Meadows. The farm grows and malts its own barley and hops on-site, and cyclists can pair a snack with locally crafted lagers and ales at the farm's tasting room. The rural Pemberton Meadows setting makes this a distinctive stop on a valley cycling route.
